ideas.title: Following the Money in the Feeding Our Future Fraud Scandal
ideas.description: Investigate the financial transactions and funding streams involved in the Feeding Our Future program to identify potential patterns of fraud and corruption.
questions: What were the funding sources for the Feeding Our Future program?
How were funds allocated and distributed?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial transactions and funding streams involved in the Feeding Our Future program, we may be able to identify potential patterns of fraud and corruption that can inform future investigations and prosecutions.
